content.value_statement: Generic outreach lowers response rates and weakens partnership discussions. This skill creates tailored messages, follow-up plans, negotiation scripts, and pipeline trackers.
actual_capabilities: Collects campaign, audience, budget, deliverable, timeline, and contact-history details.
Drafts personalized first-touch messages for direct messages, email, and management contacts.
Builds four-touch follow-up sequences with timing, channel, and purpose.
Creates negotiation options for budget gaps, scope changes, and value exchanges.
Produces pipeline tables with stages, conversion rates, priorities, and next actions.
limitations: Requires users to provide accurate target, campaign, budget, and contact details.
Does not discover influencers or verify audience quality without an external data source.
Does not finalize contracts, legal terms, media lists, embargoes, or press releases.
Does not send messages or update external systems unless an authorized connector is available.

use_cases.title: Launch a creator campaign
use_cases.description: Prepare tailored pitches and a follow-up cadence for selected creators.

use_cases.title: Pitch media contacts
use_cases.description: Turn approved media angles into concise outreach for journalists, analysts, or launch partners.

use_cases.title: Negotiate partnership scope
use_cases.description: Compare rates and budgets, then draft options that adjust compensation, deliverables, or future value.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a first message
prompt_templates.prompt: Write outreach to @[handle] for [campaign]. Use their [specific content] and offer [compensation] for [deliverable].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: one creator and one clear offer

prompt_templates.title: Create channel variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a short direct message and a formal email for [creator]. Use [campaign details], [budget], [timeline], and [personalization points].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: adapt one pitch for two channels

prompt_templates.title: Build a follow-up sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-touch cadence for [target list]. Add new value at each step and archive non-responders after day 21.

prompt_templates.title: Plan negotiation and tracking
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare each creator's ask with [budget]. Propose scope and value options, draft objection responses, and build a prioritized pipeline tracker.

output_examples.input: Draft outreach for a sustainability creator promoting compostable skincare packaging.
output: Personalization: Reference the creator's recent zero-waste bathroom content.
Offer: Paid post and stories, product access, and creative freedom.
Next step: Ask whether the creator wants the full brief.

output_examples.input: Negotiate a creator rate above the campaign budget.
output: Gap summary: Compare the requested rate, available budget, and required deliverables.
Options: Reduce scope, add affiliate commission, or propose a longer partnership.
Response: Present the budget clearly and ask which option fits.

output_examples.input: Organize outreach for ten launch partners.
output: Pipeline: Track contacted, responded, negotiating, confirmed, declined, and archived targets.
Priorities: List overdue follow-ups and active negotiations first.
Health: Calculate response rate, confirmation rate, and average time to confirm.

best_practices: Verify every personalization detail, result, testimonial, and link before using it.
Add new value in each follow-up and stop after the documented cadence.
Record consent, contact history, agreed rates, status, and next actions consistently.
anti_patterns: Do not invent creator research, campaign results, client names, testimonials, or URLs.
Do not send identical messages across targets or channels.
Do not pressure non-responders, follow up daily, or continue after a clear refusal.

faq.question: Can this skill find influencers?
faq.answer: No. Provide a target list or use a discovery tool before starting outreach.

faq.question: Can it send emails or direct messages?
faq.answer: It drafts content and schedules. Sending requires an authorized email or direct-message connector.

faq.question: Does it support journalists and analysts?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide approved media angles, claims, and embargo terms from your media relations workflow.

faq.question: Can it negotiate partnership rates?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares the ask and budget, then proposes compensation, scope, and future-value options.

faq.question: Does it create contracts?
faq.answer: No. Use a contract workflow after both parties agree on commercial terms.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide target details, campaign context, personalization evidence, compensation, deliverables, timeline, and prior contact history.
